data.title: PR-22 IMPL-09 receipt policy decision (fresh review after sync onto bn-19gw: verdict and classification recomputed inside verify; no API accepts a verdict)

data.body: [INFO] risk:high assessment. Failure modes: a stale or claimed allow, an unclassified or undiffable diff, failed or undecided gates, and a pre-passed gate 12 must not create a license. Lines 1684-1685 compute PolicyVerdict from the resolved transaction and the diff re-derived in this verification, then compare the closed claim token; all cases fail closed. Edge cases: same-version cached verdict injection has no input API; policy.rs:340-360 rejects another-version diffs and computes directly; policy.rs:403-455 makes absent classification and every non-eligible verdict non-promotable; receipt.rs:1669-1676 rejects gate 12 already passed. Rollback: revert this range before any promotion consumer lands; repair.promote is not served here. Monitoring: audit future promotion consumers for lineage-head and all remaining ReceiptSeam checks, and monitor typed PolicyDecision refusals. Validation: static review covered the whole persisted range and every changed file; the focused unit and integration tests cover changed-store, malformed claim, blocked, inconclusive, privileged-revision, and verdict cross-product cases. Tests were not executed because this reviewer may write only Seal metadata. No reportable finding. The separate risk:critical human gate remains required.
